newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's Moussa to Saudi Arabia for Sudan talks.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's Moussa to Saudi Arabia for Sudan talks.

text.p: Egyptian Foreign Minister Amr Moussa left on Saturday for Saudi Arabia for talks on Arab affairs and fighting in Sudan, foreign ministry sources said.

They said that during his two-day visit, Moussa would deliver a letter to Saudi Arabia's King Fahd from Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak. He would also meet Saudi Foreign Minister Prince Saud al-Faisal.
Sudanese Vice President al-Zubeir Mohammad Saleh held talks with King Fahd last week during a regional tour to brief Arab leaders about the fighting which erupted earlier this month in his country.

Sudan maintains that Ethiopia and Eritrea are behind the clashes in the east and that both states are using rebels to fight for them. Egypt denies the presence of any foreign troops but other Arab states, like Jordan and Yemen, support Sudan's version of events.
